title: Billing Delay and the Telephone Fee — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Accounting rule.** The telephone-fee billing-delay rate on a call-center redemption of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers counts the calendar days from the date of the redemption to the date the telephone fee is booked:

- more than 21 days: **0.60**;
- at least 8 and no more than 21 days: **0.80**;
- fewer than 8 days: **1**.

The redemption date is the date of the call-center redemption entry the fee belongs to. The booking date is the day the telephone fee entry is booked.

## Bands with both edges (hypothetical redemption dated 1 June 2026)

| Fee booked on | Calendar days after the redemption | Billing-delay rate |
|---|---|---|
| 8 June 2026 | 7 | 1 |
| 9 June 2026 | 8 | 0.80 |
| 22 June 2026 | 21 | 0.80 |
| 23 June 2026 | 22 | 0.60 |

A fee booked on the same day as the redemption is 0 days after it, which gives a rate of 1.
